name: geisha-lang
description: Syntax highlighting and Language Server Protocol (LSP) support for the Geisha programming language (.gsa)

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('language-configuration.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('syntaxes/geisha.tmLanguage.json','utf8')); console.log('VS Code extension manifests & grammar valid.');" && node test/lsp_client.test.js

geisha.lsp.path.description: Path to the `geisha` CLI executable used to launch `geisha lsp`.

geisha.lsp.args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the `geisha` executable to start the LSP server.

geisha.lsp.trace.description: Trace JSON-RPC messages between VS Code and `geisha lsp` in the Geisha output channel.
